scripts.predev: rm -rf apps/web/.next && lsof -ti :3000,8000 | xargs -r kill -9 || true
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && concurrently "cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000" "cd apps/web && npm run dev"
scripts.backend: npm run db:migrate && cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:new: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:rollback: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m alembic downgrade -1
scripts.db:status: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m alembic current --verbose
